phases.title: Freeze and measure
phases.scope: Pin upstream main SHAs, build the C++ reference, enumerate tests and system behavior, collect baseline workloads, evaluate Avian/Rapier, define demand-driven system activation
phases.acceptance: Reproducible reference image and commands; complete test ledger; benchmark raw data; backend decision; explicit environment failures

phases.title: Foundations and gates
phases.scope: Create Cargo workspace and independent repo contracts, pin versions/toolchain, implement required pre-commit/CI, time/frames/IDs, message and SDF minimums
phases.acceptance: Gate failure demonstrations; >95% coverage on initial production code; dependency graph checks; no window/GPU dependency in the core build

phases.title: End-to-end server
phases.scope: Load a simple SDF world, spawn entities, step TPE and one dynamic backend, publish clock/poses and IMU through transport, pause/reset/remove
phases.acceptance: Original and Rust runs agree on selected assertions; legacy C++ transport peer interoperates; bounded queues; first measured performance report

phases.title: Physics and robotics
phases.scope: Complete capability-based DART, MuJoCo, TPE, and chosen Rust integration; controllers, joints, contacts, lifecycle
phases.acceptance: Per-backend conformance results and negative capability tests; DART same-engine parity; no silent fallback; articulation and dynamic topology probes

phases.title: Bevy rendering and sensors
phases.scope: Asset pipeline, offscreen rendering, camera family, lidar, scheduling/noise, environmental and non-rendered sensors
phases.acceptance: Full sensor inventory mapped; GPU fixture tests and analytic tolerances; deterministic timestamps; GPU/CPU overload and reset tests

phases.title: Remaining simulator behavior
phases.scope: All remaining 78-system inventory entries, world services, levels/distributed behavior, recording/replay, scripting contracts
phases.acceptance: Every retained behavior has an implementation and tests; no unexplained unmapped cases; legacy client and log compatibility evidence

phases.title: Integration and optimization
phases.scope: External GUI contract, mixed-version repos, packaging, profiling, bottleneck removal, lifecycle stress
phases.acceptance: Performance budgets met at equal fidelity; long-run tests; package installation and clean shutdown on supported Linux targets

phases.title: Release qualification
phases.scope: Full suite, release feature matrix, coverage, documentation, upgrade story, license provenance
phases.acceptance: All required jobs pass on release commit; >95% thresholds; no unresolved retained-scope test failures; reproducible release artifacts
